newsitem.title: UK: NWE mogas $8 and more stronger on downed crackers.
newsitem.headline: NWE mogas $8 and more stronger on downed crackers.

text.p: NWE gasoline gained at least $8 a tonne on Friday as news of problems at three catalytic crackers at three separate NWE refineries added to an already bullish market.
Tight supplies in both NWE and the Mediterranean combined with strong U.S. demand was a receipe for stronger prices, dealers said.

One of Shell Pernis' cat crackers will be down for three months with a loss of 28,000 bpd of gasoline production, the BP/Texco Nerefco unit lost its 55,000 bpd cat craker for a few days and the BP/Mobil Coryton site will be without its 60,000 bpd cat cracker until the middle to end of next week.

Antwerp barges traded in the morning at $212-213.50 with swaps in August gaining as much as $5-6 with $210.00, $211.00 and $212.00 done. August/September traded on the swaps at around $11 and September was concluded at $198.50 and $198.75.
